title: Attention-complete panel to next-day return
claim: Causal attention and cross-sectional rank improve next-day asset return forecasts over the strongest market-only model.
mechanism: Cross-sectional attention identifies slower information diffusion into relatively neglected or newly salient assets.

evidence.summary: The elastic-net winner passed 2/6 development folds; blind July was worse than baseline and improved in only 3/10 assets, Holm-adjusted p=1.0.

nextAction: Keep the opened version rejected; do not rescue it with alternate assets, estimators, or thresholds.
